docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Admonitions
docs.text:
Work Sample / Social media profiles

GitHub

It contains various articles that fulfill various purposes. Some articles explain the steps involved in installation of certain Linux distributions. There are also some articles that list out the applications for various tasks.

Case-Study on Hashnode :

Hashnode

There are numerous case studies for some day to day functions on Linux. Through these, we can try to solve the issues that we generally face while using Linux as a daily driver.

Blog on Medium :

Medium

There are numerous articles on various topics that provide some personal opinions. These articles can give you a general insight on the topics that may be of interest to the readers.

docs.title: Code examples
docs.text:
An example of a codeblock for Python:

add_numbers.py
# Function to add two numbers
def add_two_numbers(num1, num2):
    return num1 + num2

# Example usage
result = add_two_numbers(5, 3)
print('The sum is:', result)

Example codeblock for JavaScript with lines highlighted:

concatenate_strings.js
// Function to concatenate two strings
function concatenateStrings(str1, str2) {
  return str1 + str2;
}

// Example usage
const result = concatenateStrings("Hello, ", "World!");
console.log("The concatenated string is:", result);
